cover.title: Huang Yi & KUKA
cover.venue: Museum of Science’s Public Science Common
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: More than just an amusing exercise in blending dance and technology. The New York Times

sections.title: Welcome
body: Taiwanese dancer and choreographer Huang Yi takes the stage with an unconventional dance partner: an industrial robot arm made by the KUKA corporation. In a time when our dance with technology can feel daunting, Huang Yi & KUKA dovetail beauty, tenderness, and nuance. They showcase the fascinating push and pull between humanity and our creations, through choreography, proving that this dynamic doesn’t always need to be a battle: it can also be a duet. Presented in partnership with Museum of Science.
